description: Give a local agent its first task and watch one loop from bead to PR: pick something small, kd create it with the project label, hand it to the agent, and review the PR. The manual form is the First task section of .claude/skills/gardenio/SKILL.md.

vars.name: project
vars.description: Project the task belongs to (the type:project bead name)

vars.name: role
vars.description: Role of the agent that does the task. `crew` stands in until the local role lands (gd-SzPJDNTBXS)

steps.title: Suggest two small, checkable first tasks in the {{project}} repo
steps.description: Read the repo and find two small tasks whose result is easy to check: a typo, a missing test, a README section. Comment both on the pick-task step, each with a one-line title and a sentence on what done looks like.

steps.title: Pick the first task for {{project}}

gate.prompt: Which first task should the agent do?

options.label: My own task (describe it in the answer)

steps.description: Decision for the person. The suggestions are on this step's comments.

steps.title: Create the first task bead in {{project}}
steps.description:
Create the task chosen at pick-task, labelled to the project so it shows in `gb ready`:

```sh
kd create "<imperative title>" --type task -l project:{{project}} \
  --short-title "<40 characters or fewer>" \
  -d '<what done looks like, in one or two sentences>'
```

Comment the new bead id on this step.

steps.title: Hand the first task to the {{project}} agent
steps.short_title: hand the task to the agent
steps.description:
Either start an agent pre-assigned to it:

```sh
gb agent start --local --role {{role}} --project {{project}} --task <bead-id>
```

or let a running agent find it with `gb ready` and then `kd claim <bead-id>`. Close this step once `kd show <bead-id>` is in_progress with the agent as assignee.

steps.title: Confirm the agent opened and linked a PR for the first task
steps.description:
The agent works on a branch, opens a PR, links it with `gb mr link <bead-id> <url>`, closes the bead and runs `gb stop`. Check:

```sh
kd show <bead-id>    # closed, with the PR linked
```

Comment the PR URL on this step.

steps.title: Review the first PR and look at it in Slack
steps.description: Human step. Review and merge (or close) the PR on the git host. In Slack, look at the task's thread and the agent card at its top; the bead is also in the viewer. Then pick a next step: add a second agent, trigger a decision with `gb decision create` and answer it in Slack, or try an escalation.
